name: com.simabroad/esim
title: SimAbroad eSIM
description: Travel eSIMs in 200+ destinations: plans for your trip, phone check, buy on simabroad.com.

tools.name: search_esim_plans
tools.description: Use this when someone needs mobile data for a trip and wants eSIM options. Pass the destination (country name in any common spelling, a 2-letter country code, or a region such as Europe, Asia or Global) and the trip length in days. Returns plans on sale now, cheapest first, with the USD price charged at checkout, an id for the other tools and a link to simabroad.com. Country searches include regional and global plans that cover it (coverage field).

destination.description: Where the traveler is going, e.g. 'Japan', 'Japón', 'JP', 'Europe'.

trip_days.description: Trip length in days; shorter plans are left out.

min_data_gb.description: Minimum data in GB. Unlimited plans always qualify.

max_price_usd.description: Only plans at or below this USD price.

include_multi_country.description: For a country, also include regional and global plans that cover it. Default true.

language.description: Language of the simabroad.com page the link opens. Default en.

limit.description: How many plans to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

tools.name: get_plan_details
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks about one plan from search_esim_plans: every country it covers, data, validity, calls or texts, how the eSIM is delivered and topped up. Pass the plan id.

language.description: Language of the simabroad.com page the link opens. Default en.

tools.name: check_device_compatibility
tools.description: Use this when the traveler asks whether their phone or tablet can use an eSIM, or before they buy if the device is unclear. Pass the model as they wrote it, e.g. 'iPhone 12', 'Galaxy S21', 'Pixel 7a'. Returns supported, likely, not_supported or unknown, with the reason and how to confirm on the device.

device.description: Phone or tablet model, e.g. 'iPhone 13 mini'.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Use this when the traveler has picked a plan and wants to buy it. Pass the plan id. Returns a simabroad.com link; the traveler opens it and pays there (card, Apple Pay or Google Pay). This tool charges nothing and needs no personal details.

language.description: Language of the simabroad.com page the link opens. Default en.
